newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary wheat extends losses, market uncertain.
newsitem.headline: Hungary wheat extends losses, market uncertain.

text.p: Hungary's milling wheat futures extended losses on Thursday on what some traders described as a technical correction.
Others, however, said fundamentals were being reassessed.
"Sellers seemed to be vigorous, but the buying side was also strong," said Mihaly Otvos of OTP Forex Kft.
Traders said the market was split over what direction prices would take in the longer term after an extended rise earlier this month on heavy rains.

Some traders said the rise was overdone given the extent of actual damage to the crop, while others said the gluten content of a very large proportion of the crop was below the Budapest Commodity Exchange's 29 percent minimum for milling wheat.
Milling wheat futures accounted for two thirds of the bourse's total grains volume of 1,604 lots, or 802.7 million forints.
Milling wheat fell by the daily limit of 400 forints for all maturities except the expiring August contract, which ended down 910 forints at 24,880.
December milling wheat finished at 27,600 forints, while March and May closed at 29,000.
Feed wheat also continued to fall, with all maturities easing 400 forints, while feed barley was mixed.
